meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会对比当前代码与npm上最新发布版本,按发布层级分类列出未发布的改动,并给出版本升级建议。它不会只看提交信息,而是分析实际代码变化。
howto.when: 当你提到「unpublished changes」「changelog」「what changed」等关键词,或询问有哪些未发布更新时触发。

say.text: 比较当前代码和最新发布的npm版本,列出未发布的改动。
say.note: Claude会读取git diff并按层级分类输出。

say.text: 有什么未发布的更改?帮我按发布层级列出来。
say.note: 会得到影响矩阵和版本建议。

say.text: 对比一下本地改动和已发布的包,有哪些新东西?
say.note: 会分析实际diff,忽略senpi相关内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude compares the current code with the latest published npm version, categorizes unpublished changes by release layer, and recommends version bumps. It reads actual diffs instead of commit messages only.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', or asking about unpublished updates.

say_en.text: Compare HEAD with latest npm version and list unpublished changes.
say_en.note: Claude reads the git diff and categorizes by layer.

say_en.text: What unpublished changes are there? List them by release layer.
say_en.note: You get the impact matrix and version recommendations.

say_en.text: Compare local changes with published packages—anything new?
say_en.note: It analyzes actual diffs and ignores senpi-related content.
